name: @misaka-net/misakanet-setup
description: MisakaNet failure lessons for your agents: writes an MCP endpoint into each agent config, rules blocks where the client takes one, and a Claude Code hook. At most one anonymous request leaves this machine at install; then only the agent's calls — unless MISAKANET_HOOK_FETCH=1 (off by default) the hook sends the failed call's error text or command.
